passage_requests.question: Which previously published dimension seven sterile-neutrino operator bases have redundancy or missing operators and what is the corrected independent basis? Identify exact affected operators and use of equations of motion integration by parts and flavor relations.

How do dimension six redundant Green basis operators combine with dimension five Weinberg insertions under field redefinitions to contribute at dimension seven? What basis reduction relations and lower-order insertions are required?

What corrections or completion to one-loop νSMEFT renormalization group equations are obtained? What role do dimension five and dimension six operator insertions and redundancies field redefinitions play? What dimension is covered?

Locate explicit field redefinitions equations 13 and 14, the sterile and lepton source terms, canonical normalization and statements on setting redundant operators to zero only after differentiating bare renormalization relations. How are lower-order dimension-five terms propagated under field redefinitions?
